_source: Liquidity-trap alert from scheduler.py (live numbers are read from strategy1_rules.json -> liquidity_trap_alerts and override the defaults below) + the 'cliff behind a wall' idea from the Trading with Siddhant option-chain video (14:50). Edit numbers here, not in code.

cliff._rule: Wall = max-OI put strike at/below spot (call strike at/above), within window_pts. Cliff ratio = average OI of the next 2 strikes beyond the wall / wall OI; thin if below thin_below. Break = spot moves from the wall's side to beyond it by break_buffer_pts between two snapshots.

history._min_z: The gap vs the shuffled control must also be at least min_z standard errors - on made-up random data a 0.11 R gap on 228 trades appeared by luck (1.4 x noise).
